import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    length = int(input_data[0])
    sequence = list(input_data[1])
    max_segment = 0
    nested_count = 0
    index = 0
    while index < length:
        if sequence[index] == '(':
            temp_count = 0
            j = index + 1
            while j < length:
                if sequence[j] == ')':
                    if temp_count > 0:
                        nested_count += 1
                    break
                if sequence[j] == '_':
                    if temp_count > 0:
                        nested_count += 1
                        temp_count = 0
                else:
                    temp_count += 1
                j += 1
        elif sequence[index] == ')' or sequence[index] == '_':
            count = 0
            j = index + 1
            while j < length and sequence[j] not in [')', '_', '(']:
                count += 1
                j += 1
            if count > max_segment:
                max_segment = count
        else:
            count = 0
            j = index
            while j < length and sequence[j] not in [')', '_', '(']:
                count += 1
                j += 1
            if count > max_segment:
                max_segment = count
            index += count - 1
        index += 1
    print(f"{max_segment} {nested_count}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
